candidates.exact_span: If there is no discharge from any outfall during the sampling month, place an "X" in the NO DISCHARGE box located in the upper right corner of the Discharge Monitoring Report.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of when no-discharge must be reported (any outfall, sampling month scope, and the NO DISCHARGE box mechanism) affects whether monitoring was required without numeric results (B) and whether missing numeric data reflects a documented no-discharge period versus another no-data state or unresolved case (C).

candidates.exact_span: If any daily maximum or monthly average value exceeds the effluent limitations specified in Part I. A, the permittee shall report the excursion in accordance with the requirements of Part III. D.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a reported daily maximum or monthly average is treated as exceeding Part I.A effluent limitations, and whether that triggers excursion reporting under Part III.D, changes exceedance/limit-comparison outcomes (A) and the set of applicable reporting obligations tied to limit excursions (B).

candidates.exact_span: Any daily maximum or monthly average value reported in the required Discharge Monitoring Report which is in excess of the effluent limitation specified in Part I. A shall constitute evidence of violation of such effluent limitation and of this permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of which reported statistic (daily maximum vs monthly average) is compared to Part I.A effluent limitations, and when an excess value counts as violation evidence, changes whether measurement/limit pairs are classified as exceeding enforceable limits versus non-operative or unresolved comparisons (A).
